headline_of_the_week.title: Europe is heading for its third-biggest female founder funding year and all-female teams still get 1 percent of it
headline_of_the_week.summary: PitchBook's European VC female founders dashboard shows EUR 9.7 billion in deal value to female founders so far in 2026, nearly matching 2025's annual total and putting 2026 on pace to be the third-highest year on record by capital. All-female founding teams account for 1 percent of deal value this year, down from 1.3 percent in 2025. Mixed teams rose to 16.3 percent from 15 percent.

headlines.title: Auxxo closes Female Catalyst Fund II at EUR 33.3 million and adds a founder matching platform
headlines.summary: Berlin-based Auxxo reached final close on its second Female Catalyst Fund at EUR 33.3 million, 75 percent larger than its EUR 19 million debut vehicle. More than half of the fund's investors are women, it has backed eleven companies to date and two portfolio companies have already secured follow-on financing from other VCs. Auxxo paired the close with a founder matching platform for pre-seed and seed teams.

headlines.title: Barilla acquires Goodles, the mac-and-cheese brand co-founded by Gal Gadot and led by CEO Jen Zeszut
headlines.summary: Barilla Group, the world's largest pasta company, agreed to acquire Goodles, founded in October 2020 as Gooder Foods and co-founded by actress Gal Gadot. Co-founder and CEO Jen Zeszut will continue to lead the 73-employee team and Goodles will operate as a standalone business. Financial terms were not disclosed.

headlines.title: DivInc names Tauri Laws-Philips CEO and relaunches its Women in Tech Accelerator
headlines.summary: DivInc appointed Tauri Laws-Philips as chief executive and relaunched its Women in Tech Accelerator. Laws-Philips supported more than 200 founders through her work at Andreessen Horowitz across a 15-year career. In DivInc's latest cohort, 89 percent of participating founders reported gaining sustainable traction, about two-thirds reached or made significant progress toward product-market fit, and 100 percent named pitching and storytelling as a core growth area.

headlines.title: iPremom raises EUR 15 million seed led by Amadeus Capital Partners to predict pregnancy complications from a blood test
headlines.summary: Valencia-based molecular diagnostics startup iPremom raised a EUR 15 million seed round led by Amadeus Capital Partners through the Amadeus APEX Technology Fund, with participation from Asabys Partners and APEX Ventures. It was the largest disclosed femtech round of the week.

headlines.title: Femtech companies took USD 621.8 million across 36 disclosed equity deals in the month just closed
headlines.summary: A monthly femtech funding analysis counted 36 disclosed equity deals across 35 companies totalling USD 621.825 million, giving a concrete read on how much capital the women's health category is absorbing while all-female founding teams lose share of broader European deal value.
